# Leaflet 1.9.4

Pinned browser distribution downloaded from https://unpkg.com/leaflet@1.9.4/.
Source: https://github.com/Leaflet/Leaflet/tree/v1.9.4
Licence: BSD-2-Clause; see LICENSE in this directory.

CSS, JavaScript, source map and the five distribution images are unmodified.
CampusNav serves these files locally so the library does not depend on CDN
availability. Only OpenStreetMap background tiles are requested online, directly
by the browser; they are not bundled or prefetched.
